subject: Starlane service impact — mitigation, credit calculation & contract amendment
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@starlane.io>
To: hiro.tanaka@redwood.com
Cc: legal@starlane.io
Date: Sun, 12 May 2028 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Production impact — latency + 5xx spike (May 12)

Hi Hiro,

We're seeing a sustained latency increase and elevated 5xx rates across our model endpoints since ~03:00 UTC this morning. Traffic dropped through our app as retries compounded; our Ops dashboard captured multiple user-facing errors. We've attached examples from our logs.

High level impact:~15% of requests experienced >2s latency, and 1.8% 5xx rate for a 3-hour window (03:00–06:00 UTC). This pushed us over our SLA for the month and triggered internal exec attention.

We need: immediate ETA on root cause, a mitigation plan to avoid recurrence, and a proposed service remedy/credit to present to our CFO today.

Thanks,
Priya
Senior Infrastructure Lead | Starlane Inc.
Attachments: starlane_error_log_20280512.csv
From: hiro.tanaka@redwood.com <hiro.tanaka@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@starlane.io>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 12 May 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production impact — latency + 5xx spike (May 12)

Hi Priya — thank you for the log snippets and the heads-up. I'm very sorry for the disruption.

Quick notes: I've looped in Marissa (ops) and Ben (commercial) to triage. Our on-call is already digging into the traces. We'll provide an initial incident summary in the next 90 minutes and a temporary mitigation ETA.

Interim ask for you: can you confirm the affected model routes (prompt templates) and whether any rollout or traffic routing changed from your side between 02:00–04:00 UTC?

I'll follow up with a proposed credit calculation once we have the impact window locked down.

Best,
Hiro Tanaka
Head of Customer Reliability | Redwood Inference
From: marissa.cole@redwood.com <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: hiro.tanaka@redwood.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 12 May 2028 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production impact — latency + 5xx spike (May 12)

FYI — initial triage notes (ops):
- Root cause: a regression in our autoscaling scheduler combined with a KV cache invalidation pattern when certain short-sequence requests spiked. This caused per-host tokenization queues to stall briefly, increasing p99 latency and producing transient 503s.
- Window of impact: 2028-05-12T03:05:00Z — 2028-05-12T06:20:00Z (confirmed by tracing).
- Mitigation applied: forced cache-warm + temporary scale-up to additional GPU pool at 06:22Z; error rate returned to baseline at ~06:35Z.
- Preventive steps: patch to scheduler rolling out now, add guardrails to cache invalidation, and add a circuit-breaker for tokenization queue pressure.

I'll prepare a short exec brief (attached). Marissa
Operations Lead | Redwood Inference
Attachments: exec_brief_starlane_20280514.pdf
From: hiro.tanaka@redwood.com <hiro.tanaka@redwood.com>
To: Amit Rao <amit.rao@starlane.io>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@starlane.io>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 May 2028 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed make-good offer and contract amendment path

Hi Amit / Priya — following our engineering analysis and the exec brief, we want to outline a remediation offer and next steps to make this right.

1) Technical remediation summary (short): patch to autoscaler scheduler deployed to prod, KV cache guard and circuit-breaker in canary; expected to close recurrence vector. Full rollout by 2028-05-16.

2) Credit proposal: per the SLA (99.9% availability target), the observed 3h15m window with sustained p95/p99 violations equates to a credit of 5% of May invoice, pro-rated to the impacted routes. We're proposing a 6% invoice credit to include forgiveness for downstream retry amplification and operational disruption. See attached spreadsheet for line-item calc. (sla_credit_calc_20280515.xlsx)

3) Contract amendment: we propose a short-form amendment to clarify the SLA measurement window, add an incident notification timeline (24h for initial summary, 72h for postmortem), and an explicit rollback/fallback policy to reduce customer impact in multi-tenant scenarios. We can share a draft DocuSign today for Starlane legal review.

4) Exec ask: we'd like a 30-minute review with your CFO / Head of Ops to align on the credit math and amendment language. Ben — can you lead commercial? Laura — pls prep draft amendment and a one-pager on the operational changes.

Hiro
From: ben.carter@redwood.com <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: hiro.tanaka@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 May 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed make-good offer and contract amendment path

LGTM on the approach. A couple of commercial notes:
- Confirming 6% credit applied to May invoice (deal SL-2027-042) but limited to affected SKUs/routes — we should be explicit about which billing lines are eligible so accounting can process quickly.
- We'll offer the credit as an invoice adjustment rather than an account credit to avoid multi-month reconciliation complexity.
- If Starlane requests faster turnaround on the amendment, we can expedite DocuSign and offer a one-time waiver on the standard 30-day review for the limited change set.

I'll join the CFO call if scheduled. Ben
VP Sales | Redwood Inference
From: hiro.tanaka@redwood.com <hiro.tanaka@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@starlane.io>, Amit Rao <amit.rao@starlane.io>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 May 2028 17:42:00 -0700
Subject: Final proposal: 6% May invoice credit + amendment draft

Hi Priya / Amit — thanks for the call earlier. Following our discussion, this is our final proposal: 

- Credit: 6% of the May 2028 invoice, applied to the affected endpoints (routes: /v1/generate-text, /v1/chat/completions for customer workspace starlane-prod). This will appear as an adjustment on your May invoice.
- Amendment: short-form SLA clarification + notification timelines + rollback policy. We've uploaded a draft to DocuSign for Starlane Legal: https://www.docusign.com/SL-2027-042-amendment
- Next steps: Starlane to confirm approval on the credit and sign the amendment (or provide redlines) by 2028-05-22. Upon signature, Redwood will arrange the invoice adjustment and provide the full postmortem.

Please confirm and we'll route the DocuSign to legal. Very sorry again for the disruption — we appreciate your patience.

Best,
Hiro Tanaka
Head of Customer Reliability | Redwood Inference
